turns.text: You want to use this new software for our project, but I'm hesitant. Can you tell me exactly why this is better than the old system?

transcript: First, the new software saves us time, because it formats the citations for us. Second, it's free with our student login. Third, my roommate uses it for gaming and it's super fun.
